input: Schedule a hearing test at the audiologist

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is for the user themselves or someone else (e.g., a child, elderly parent) affects who needs to be contacted, what type of test is needed, and who manages the booking.
The reason for the test — routine check, suspected hearing loss, tinnitus, follow-up — determines the type of appointment to request and what to tell the clinic.
Whether the user already has a specific audiologist/clinic in mind or needs help finding one is the most immediate next action determining factor.
A referral may be required by insurance or a healthcare system before booking; if so, that step must happen first.
The user's availability and preferred timeframe (e.g., urgency, days of week, time of day) directly shapes which appointment slots to target.
Preferences around location, travel distance, or whether in-person vs. telehealth is acceptable narrow down which providers are suitable.
Knowing whether 'done' means the appointment is confirmed on the calendar, or just that the user has the clinic's contact details and next steps, defines where the task ends.

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a hearing test at the audiologist
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book an appointment for a hearing test with an audiologist.

questions.title: Who is this hearing test for?
questions.description: Establish whether the appointment is for the user themselves or for another person (e.g., child, parent, partner), as this affects the booking process and test type.

questions.title: What is the main reason for getting tested?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose — routine check-up, noticeable hearing loss, tinnitus, post-illness follow-up, etc. — so the right type of appointment is requested from the clinic.

questions.title: Do you already have an audiologist or clinic in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preferred provider or needs help identifying one before the booking call or form can be initiated.

questions.title: Do you need a doctor's referral before booking?
questions.description: Find out if the user's insurance plan or healthcare system requires a GP/physician referral first, which would make that an essential prerequisite step.

questions.title: How soon do you need this appointment?
questions.description: Understand the urgency and any preferred days or times of day, so the search for available slots can be appropriately targeted.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the clinic?
questions.description: Capture location or distance preferences, and whether telehealth/remote consultations are acceptable, to filter suitable providers.

questions.title: What does 'done' look like — confirmed booking or just next steps?
questions.description: Clarify whether the task is complete once the appointment is confirmed on the calendar, or if the user just needs the clinic details and a clear action to take next.
